items.summary: TEHRAN — Saleh Zahran’s olive trees are ripening and rotting at the same time. The 39-year-old farmer inherited 120 of them near Deir Abu Mishal, west of Ramallah, and this season he reached about 20.

ai.sum: An Iranian outlet reports on settler attacks and land seizures against Palestinian farmers in the West Bank.

items.title: National school tests held despite education minister's attempt to cancel them after AG's intervention
items.summary: Kisch sought to discredit the testing authority after poor results exposed the state of Israeli education. But an external review he commissioned found the tests reliable, prompting the attorney general to intervene

ai.sum: Education Minister Kisch tried to cancel national school tests after poor results, but an external review found them reliable and the attorney general intervened.
